name: Soniox - Speech to Text AI
oneLine: The speech recognition company's own app: live transcription and translation of conversations in 60+ languages, with speaker labels and AI summaries, on phone, desktop and web.

platforms.text: iPhone, iPad, Android, Mac, Windows, web
platforms.detail: Phone apps on the App Store and Google Play, a desktop app for Mac and Windows, and a web app to review and share recordings. The web app cannot record.

deviceRequirements.detail: The App Store lists iOS 16.4 or later for iPhone and iPadOS 16.4 or later for iPad (October 2026). The Android version needed is not shown on the Google Play page we opened.

roomCaptions.detail: Soniox says the app works through the phone's microphone and captions speech around you word by word. Live captions need internet and the app open on screen.

groupConversations.detail: One phone captions the group and labels each speaker. Shared projects organise saved transcripts; Soniox describes no way to join several phones into one live conversation.

languages.detail: Soniox lists 60 languages for live captions and translation, including speech where people switch languages mid-sentence. You can set language hints for the languages you expect.

offline.detail: Live transcription works only when the app is online and open on screen. Offline or in the background it keeps recording, and the transcript is made once you are back online.

speakerLabels.detail: Speaker diarization labels the text Speaker 1, Speaker 2 and so on, live and in saved recordings. You can rename speakers in a saved recording, and every line of that speaker updates.

translation.detail: Translate to shows the original and a translation into one language. Translate between shows two boxes, one per language, and the top box can be rotated for the person sitting across from you.

saveTranscripts.text: Yes; audio on the phone, text synced
saveTranscripts.detail: Saved audio stays only on your phone and is deleted if you uninstall the app. Transcripts, translations and summaries sync to your account and the web app. Playback needs the audio on the phone.

export.detail: Share a private web link to the transcript with speaker labels and AI results, share the text, or send the audio file (.m4a) through the phone's share menu.

fileUpload.text: Audio files in the Mac and Windows app
fileUpload.detail: The help centre describes uploading an existing audio file in the desktop app for Mac and Windows. It describes no file import in the phone app.

summaries.text: Summary, to-dos, quotes, your own prompts
summaries.detail: Summary, key points, to-do list, speaker summary, speaker quotes and named entities, plus your own questions about a transcript (custom prompts). On the Free plan, AI actions use credits.

customWords.text: Yes, context notes for names and terms
customWords.detail: Before recording you can add short notes about names, terms or the topic, and language hints. A saved recording can be re-transcribed with new settings, which uses credits.

display.text: Larger text, dark mode, rotate text
display.detail: The App Store lists larger text (200% or more) and a dark interface. In two-way translation the top box can be turned to face the other person. Soniox lists no caption colour settings.

soundAlerts.detail: Soniox's app pages and help centre describe no alerts for sounds such as a doorbell or an alarm.

phoneCalls.detail: Soniox's pages mention recording and captioning calls, but do not say how a call on the same phone is captured.

videoCalls.detail: The Mac and Windows app records and transcribes meetings and calls, but Soniox does not say whether it captures a Zoom or Teams call's sound.

mediaOnDevice.detail: The help centre suggests Translate to for videos in languages you don't understand, but does not say whether the app can caption sound playing on the same phone.

humanCaptioners.detail: No human captioning service is described on Soniox's app pages or in its help centre.

signLanguage.detail: No sign language feature is described. Soniox's accessibility page presents the app as a way to follow speech without sign language or lip reading.

privacy.text: Cloud for live text; audio kept on the phone
privacy.detail: While online, audio streams for live transcription and is processed immediately, not stored. Saved audio stays on the phone; audio uploaded for processing is deleted afterwards. Soniox says it never uses your audio to train AI.

account.detail: You create an account in the app or on the web; the same account works in the phone and web apps. Soniox's developer Console is a separate product with separate accounts.

availability.text: App Store and Google Play; countries not listed
availability.detail: On the App Store and Google Play. Soniox does not list the countries. The App Store lists English as the only language of the app's own screens.

freePlan.detail: Free credits are added every week and don't roll over; Soniox doesn't say how much audio a credit covers. When they run out, live transcription turns off but the app keeps recording. Soniox says Free and Pro use the same models.

price.detail: Soniox Pro on the US App Store, October 2026 (US$19.99 to US$119.99 on Google Play). The help centre lists US$19.99 a month, or US$120 a year at 50% off. Pro is unlimited and can't be shared with family.

accessibilityFunding.detail: Soniox's pricing pages describe Free and Pro only, with no funding programme or discount for deaf and hard of hearing users.

strengths.text: Live captions and live translation in 60+ languages, including speech that switches languages mid-sentence, with one-way and two-way modes.
Runs on phones, on Mac and Windows, and on the web, with one shared balance of credits.
AI actions include summaries, to-dos, quotes per speaker and your own questions about a transcript.
Saved audio stays on your phone, and Soniox says it never uses your audio to train AI.

limits.text: Live transcription works only online with the app open on screen; in the background or offline it only records.
The Free plan gives 10 credits a week that don't roll over; Pro costs US$19.99 a month on the US App Store.
It needs a Soniox account, and the App Store lists the app's own screens in English only.
File upload is described only for the Mac and Windows app, and playback needs the audio still on the phone.

notes: This file is about the Soniox consumer app (Smart Scribe, Translator, Voice Typing), not Soniox's developer API: the app is billed as a Free/Pro subscription, so API prices are left out. Conflicts: (1) Audio: the App Store says 'Your audio recordings stay on your device' and Google Play says 'All audio to Text processing stays secure on your device', but the help centre says audio streams to Soniox for live transcription (processed immediately, not stored) and saved audio may be uploaded temporarily for the final transcript. The website says 'Soniox never stores your recordings', while the help centre says a local audio file is always saved on the phone (on the device, not on Soniox's servers). (2) Desktop: the help centre home page says the Desktop App cannot access transcriptions and can't be used with the mobile and web apps; the desktop Smart Scribe and Translator pages say desktop history syncs with mobile and web. (3) Yearly price: App Store US$119.99, help centre and pricing page US$120 (shown as US$10/month billed annually). (4) Age: the App Store rates the app 4+, but Soniox's Terms of Service (https://soniox.com/policies/terms-of-service, updated June 29, 2026) say users must be 18 or older; the privacy policy and terms are written for all Soniox services (API, Console) and don't name the consumer app. (5) The help centre's Earning credits page hides the referral credit amounts behind a component, and no page says how much audio one credit covers. The Google Play page (US) did not show the minimum Android version; its In-app purchases range is US$19.99 to US$119.99 per item. Not checked: whether the phone app can import audio or video files (only desktop upload is described), whether the desktop app captures system audio from video calls, and country availability. App Store lookup (itunes.apple.com/lookup?id=1560199731&country=us): version 3.9.0 (July 30, 2026), minimum iOS 16.4, price free, seller Soniox Inc, interface language EN. All pages opened 2026-10-28 with curl (help-centre text also read from its .mdx versions).
